In 1981, Mary Day disappeared from her parents’ home in Pennsylvania. It was assumed that she ran away. But over the years, her sisters began to suspect that she might have died at the hands of a family member. Then, just as an investigation got underway to prove she was murdered, she reappeared in Phoenix, Arizona. But was this the real Mary Day, or someone claiming to be her?
